question: which districts have higher full immunisation coverage in 2023? give all in order

which districts have higher full immunisation coverage in 2023? give all in order
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH
  districts AS (
    SELECT "district" FROM "immunisation" WHERE "year" = 2023 AND "source" IN ('synthetic smoke fixture')
  ),
  coverage AS (
    SELECT "district", "children_fully_immunised" / NULLIF("children_due", 0) AS coverage
    FROM "immunisation" WHERE "year" = 2023 AND "source" IN ('synthetic smoke fixture')
  )
SELECT "district", coverage
FROM districts
ORDER BY coverage DESC;
```
